text:
marta: Quick follow-up from the Aureus postmortem — root cause looks like an asymmetric route + on-prem NAT race that produced intermittent VPC peering loops. Need owners + timelines for: network remediation, on‑prem config audit, CI validation, and monitoring. cc @sanjay @lena

sanjay: I can own the network remediation. Plan: patch route-propagation scripts to add de-dup checks and backstop route hygiene, plus a short rollback playbook. Will open PR today. ETA: EOD Thu.

lena: I’ll own the on-prem audit with Aureus infra. Will run the pairing checklist, collect NAT/kernel logs, and confirm whether vendor patch is needed. Need Aureus contact + maintenance window.

vika: @lena done — intro DM to Aureus ops sent (thread with contact). Filed ticket INC-4521 and assigned to ops-net.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-4521 — "Aureus on-prem NAT/peering drift detection" — assignee: ops-net — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4521

jack: For validation I'll add an automated e2e test in blueprints that simulates dual-path convergence (simulated flaps, NAT translation toggles) and asserts no loopback. Drafting test harness now; will push branch and link here. ETA: next Fri.

marta: Action-item summary (added to postmortem doc):
1) sanjay — route de-dup & backstop patch (PR -> #PR-782) — ETA Thu EOD
2) lena — on-prem config audit with Aureus, collect kernel/NAT logs, escalate vendor patch if needed — ETA Tue next week
3) jack — e2e regression test + CI job (blueprints) — ETA Fri next week
4) vika — customer intro + schedule maintenance window; ensure Aureus signs off on vendor contact — ETA tomorrow
5) add monitoring alert for path asymmetry and route flaps (owner: sanjay)

marta: @sanjay can you add a Grafana panel + alert? Looking for condition: packet loss > 0.5% OR route flaps > 3 in 5m.

sanjay: Yep. Will add panel and alert with the following query as a starting point:

```
sum(rate(route_flap_total{customer="aureus"}[5m])) by (peer)
```

Also adding packet loss metric: 
```
sum(rate(packet_loss_total{customer="aureus"}[5m])) / sum(rate(packet_sent_total{customer="aureus"}[5m]))
```

lena: Small note: Aureus on-prem boxes are on kernel 4.9 and vendor has a backlog for NAT bug fixes. I’ll escalate that in INC-4521 and request a compatibility plan.

marta: Thanks — please update the postmortem with PR/test links and mark INC-4521 with milestones. Reconvene next Tue 10:00 PT for a short status check. :white_check_mark:
